messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "serious breathing problems not reported at recommended doses"
set: ["serious breathing problems not reported at recommended doses", "newborn breathing problems", "symptoms usually not serious", "doses greater than 6 mg/kg body weight are not recommended", "breathing problems may occur with overdose", "breathing problems may lead to death", "needs care in people with breathing problems", "breathing problems if combined with certain medicines", "breathing problems may occur when first starting", "breastfeeding is not recommended during treatment", "symptoms especially reported when stopped abruptly", "breathing problems may occur when dose is changed", "serious infection", "this can increase the risk of serious muscle problems", "taking more than recommended dose does not increase effectiveness", "increased risk of serious muscle problems when used with certain drugs"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
